title: HydroMind: A Checkable Agent for Autonomous Hydrological Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.23323v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: General-purpose coding agents have written code for hydrological and Earth-system models. In these studies the researchers decided in advance how the model would be evaluated, for example the test period, the scoring function, and the standard the model had to meet. No study has tested what happens when the agent makes these decisions itself: how many of its claims are supported by its own data, code, and results, and whether readers can check them. Both may depend on the agent's harness, that is, the tools it can call and the written instructions it follows. translated_title: HydroMind：面向自主水文研究的可检验智能体
translated_abstract: 通用编程智能体已经为水文和地球系统模型编写过代码。在这些研究中，研究者事先决定了模型将如何被评估，例如测试时段、评分函数以及模型需要达到的标准。尚无研究检验过当智能体自行做出这些决策时会发生什么：它的结论中有多少能被其自身的数据、代码和结果所支持，以及读者能否对这些结论进行核查。这两点都可能取决于智能体的运行框架，即它可以调用的工具以及它所遵循的书面指令。我们比较了三种运行框架：智能体自带的框架；该框架加上HydroMind的建模工具——HydroMind是我们为通用智能体开发的水文建模系统，它通过固定命令运行每个模型，并存储模型的配置设置、训练好的模型和预测结果；以及再加上HydroMind的研究流程，在该流程下，智能体在运行之前先撰写研究设计（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文开发了面向通用智能体的水文建模系统HydroMind及其建模工具和研究流程，首次检验了当自主智能体自行决定水文模型评估方案时，其结论能否被自身数据、代码和结果支持并供读者核查。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces HydroMind, a hydrological modeling system with fixed-command tools and a research procedure, and uses it to examine, for the first time, whether an autonomous agent making its own evaluation decisions in hydrological research produces claims supported by its own data, code, and results and checkable by readers.
